unit_conversion_audit.correction_of_previous_statement: AUDIT CORRECTION: In the previous summary, unit conversions were informally described as having 0% error. This final audit formally rectifies this: SI metric conversions (kg<->g, L<->ml, tsp<->ml) are mathematically EXACT with 0.0% error. However, culinary volume-to-mass conversions (tsp/tbsp to grams) and produce piece weights (onion, potato, tomato) are inherently APPROXIMATE, relying on documented agricultural and bulk density averages with estimated empirical variances ranging between ±10% and ±30%. The engine now explicitly classifies every conversion into EXACT or APPROXIMATE with source tracking.

cost_calculation_audit.procurement_coverage_guarantee: VERIFIED: Across all recipes, whole grocery package procurement covers 100% of required quantities (packages * size >= required)
cost_calculation_audit.coverage_definition_audit: VERIFIED: Price Completeness Ratio (Coverage) is strictly defined as N_priced_required / N_total_required ingredients. It is completely independent of the number of products existing for any ingredient in the catalog.
